items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Charlie McCurdy's always used a B clarinet. You see, he used to use a set of clarinet.

ctx.x: Was that here in New Orleans? Right here. Oh, they were learning while you were standing?

Right here. Charlie McCurdy's always used a B clarinet. You see, he used to use a set of clarinet. He used to use an A and a B. Mm-hmm. But they got to a place where those boys could use, you understand? Learned how to play on the A or the B clarinet, you see? Mm-hmm. Well, did you ever know a guitar player named Mumford?
Mumford? Mumford. Mumford, Mumford or something like that? Yeah, Mumford, yeah. Yeah, Brock Mumford you're talking about. Oh, Brock, yeah. Who did he play with? Eagle Band.
